office_does: The treasurer collects property taxes for the county and its taxing districts, invests public funds, and manages the county investment pool and debt.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Treasurer Alishia Topper, in office since 2019, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Clark County Treasurer since 2019 and a former Vancouver city councilmember; the only candidate.
highlights: Says the county investment pool exceeds $1 billion and allocated a record $47 million in interest last year [S1]
Reports clean financial and performance audits with no findings [S1]
